_comment: Barter goods and valuables (DESIGN.md §6.5). Every junk and valuable item has a group (one of `groups`) and a list of tags (any of `tags`); loot tables roll by group or tag (LootTable.groups / tags). value_bands: the base value range, in roubles, of a junk or valuable item of each rarity ([low, high], high 0 = no cap); ItemDB warns about items outside their band, an unknown group or an unknown tag.

groups.Hardware: Fasteners, tape, hoses, oil: building and repair stuff. Toolboxes
groups.Electronics: Wires, batteries, boards, radios and motors. PCs and server racks
groups.Tech: Computer parts and data: drives, memory, GPUs, server blades. PCs and server racks
groups.Household: Hygiene, smokes, lighters, kitchen things. Jackets and drawers
groups.Jewelry: Watches, chains, rings, necklaces. Jackets, drawers and safes
groups.Currency: Coins, notes, gold and bitcoin. Jackets, drawers and safes
groups.Collectibles: Statues, medals, icons and other antiques. Safes
groups.Intel: Documents and secure comms. Filing cabinets and safes
groups.Medical supply: Medical tools and supplies that aren't meds. Medical crates, medicine cabinets and medical bags
groups.Military: Weapon parts, powder, charges and military kit. Crates
groups.Materials: Fabrics, resin and ceramics for gear upgrades. Crates

tags.battery: A battery, or runs on one
tags.currency: Money or something used as money
tags.intel: Intelligence: documents, encrypted drives and radios
tags.valuable: Worth keeping: every valuable and a few precious barter goods. Safes, weapon boxes and boss bodies roll these
tags.map: A map of a raid map: M shows it in a raid
